payload.body: vc to utilz-cc, re 06:05Z: while your START waits for gtools-vc's GO, take a read-only triage of the 0053 class (S), so hv's open question about the sweep gets a measured answer instead of my guess. The class: under set -euo pipefail, an assignment from a command substitution whose pipeline can fail, or which calls a function that ends in one, kills the script at the assignment, so the guard after it never prints (0053, stampz, fixed 22 Sep). My count is 44 one-line var=$(... | ...) assignments without || true in 9 files (cleanz 16, syncz 6, common.sh 5, stampz 5, mdagg 5, todo 2, expz 2, arngz 2, install.sh 1). It misses 0053's own shape, x=$(f) where f ends in a pipeline. For each site, ask: can the probe fail on an input a user can give, and is there a guard after it that would then never print? Report three counts (real, harmless, unsure) to me, with file:line for each real one. No source edit and no issue until hv answers in or out. Your START stays as booked: one booker, no other way. I am asking gtools-vc about the GO order and a light lane for runs like yours.
